name: AI Authenticity Review — LLM Assessment
description: AI/LLM-based authenticity assessment. Uses heuristic analysis (local mode) or OpenAI GPT-4o API (remote mode, set OPENAI_API_KEY env var). Evaluates: (1) score credibility — are scores inflated? (2) methodology depth — are checks shallow? (3) public evidence — is the audit reproducible? (4) consistency — do scores across companies make sense? (5) bot visibility — can AI crawlers verify compliance claims?
honest_disclosure: This check uses an AI model to evaluate whether the compliance claims would survive third-party scrutiny. In LOCAL mode (default), it applies the same heuristics an LLM would use. In REMOTE mode (OPENAI_API_KEY set), it calls GPT-4o for a real LLM assessment.

assessability_legend.local: Heuristic analysis — no API key needed
assessability_legend.remote: OpenAI GPT-4o API — set OPENAI_API_KEY env var

group_policies.name: Authenticity Assessment
group_policies.description: AI evaluation of whether compliance posture is credible to third-party auditors, security researchers, and AI crawlers

items.description: AI assesses whether framework scores are credible and not inflated. Flags suspiciously high average scores, identical per-company scores, and missing public evidence.
items.regulation: AI Authenticity Review — framework score credibility analysis
items.remediation: Publish the full audit methodology. Ensure scores reflect actual assessment depth. Add explanatory notes for config_required limitations.

items.description: AI verifies that public evidence supports compliance claims: security.txt (RFC 9116), public audit report, compliance page with honest limitations.
items.regulation: AI Authenticity Review — public evidence verification
items.remediation: Publish security.txt, compliance.html, and latest_report.json at publicly accessible URLs.

items.description: AI checks that compliance metadata is visible to AI crawlers: meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, X-Compliance HTTP header, and robots.txt compliance disclosure.
items.regulation: AI Authenticity Review — AI crawler visibility assessment
items.remediation: Add compliance meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, and X-Compliance HTTP header to all pages.
